# W8-001 — Implement visual coverage for base addon

- Phase: W8
- Status: `done`

- Role: domain-designer
- Dependencies: W8-D01, W2-005, W1-008
- Parallel group: addon-visuals
- Risk: medium
- Human approval required: false

## Objective

Implement only the verified base asset references, UI compositions and state treatments based on W8-D01. Domain: People, partners, companies, users, activities, attachments, tags, records.

## Scope hints

- `apps/board/src`
- `packages/assets`
- `packages/ui`
- `packages/orm-base`

## Deliverables

- base addon asset coverage and tested UI specimens/consumer integration where a real screen exists

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Only real existing models/routes/permissions are represented.
- [x] Shared assets are reused by stable ID; no domain-specific duplicate asset copies.
- [x] Empty/loading/error/permission-denied/zero/unavailable states are distinct where applicable.
- [x] Artwork remains decorative; labels, state and actions are real UI data.

- [x] If a route does not exist, provide a labelled UI Catalog specimen and document the missing production consumer rather than inventing the route.

- `pnpm --filter @moonwitness/board typecheck`

- `pnpm test:ui-catalog`
